weapons.name: Aegis Mono-Edge
weapons.description: A flawless mirror-white longsword whose single molecule-thin edge catches the light as a hair-fine line of pure blue, its hilt seamless and cold to the touch.

weapons.name: Solarflare Greatblade
weapons.description: A gleaming two-handed greatsword sheathed in a roaring corona of caged plasma, gold filigree channels glowing white-hot along a blade that hums with contained sun-fire.

weapons.name: Hardlight Sabre
weapons.description: A slim emitter-hilt of polished chrome projects a translucent cyan blade of solidified light that flickers crisply into existence with each precise, weightless cut.

weapons.name: Tempest Gauntlets
weapons.description: A matched pair of sleek armored energy gauntlets that crackle with arcs of blue lightning across knuckle-mounted emitters, snapping out a flurry of shock-charged blows.

weapons.name: Glacier Tech-Glaive
weapons.description: An elegant long-hafted glaive of brushed platinum tipped with a sculpted cryo-blade that sheds curling frost-vapor, its sweeping reach freezing the air it carves through.

weapons.name: Pulsehammer Maul
weapons.description: A massive industrial fusion-maul, its scorched titanium head ringed with vent-slits that flare orange and unleash a concussive shockwave on every earth-cracking slam.

weapons.name: Voidrazor Daggers
weapons.description: Twin obsidian-black tech-daggers whose mono-edges drink the light, trailing wisps of purple void-static as they flicker in a blindingly fast dual-wield dance.

weapons.name: Halcyon Phaseblade
weapons.description: An immaculate ceremonial tech-katana of seamless ivory alloy, its mono-edge shimmering with a faint golden phase-field that makes each draw-cut whisper-clean and surgical.

weapons.name: Caustic Tech-Spear
weapons.description: A scuffed gunmetal energy-spear with a long thrusting reach, its emitter-tip injecting a hissing bead of luminous green toxin that bleeds down the haft's grooves.

weapons.name: Nova Warhammer
weapons.description: A regal gold-and-white plasma warhammer crowned with a radiant arcane core, its gem-set head detonating a brilliant burst of starlight at the apex of each overhead crush.

weapons.name: Stormcleaver Mono-Axe
weapons.description: A gleaming bright-steel war-axe with a wide mono-edged blade lined in arcing electric-blue conduits, snapping out a crackling discharge with every wide, heavy swing.

weapons.name: Dawncleaver
weapons.description: A flawless mirror-bright knightly longsword with a cruciform gold-inlaid guard that catches sunlight like a struck bell.

weapons.name: Graveiron Greatsword
weapons.description: A massive notch-edged greatsword of dark pitted iron, its leather-wrapped ricasso sweat-stained and its fuller crusted with old rust.

weapons.name: Riverbend Falchion Pair
weapons.description: A matched pair of broad single-edged falchions with weathered horn grips and bellied edges that flash in tight overlapping arcs.

weapons.name: Seraph's Bardiche
weapons.description: A broad crescent-bladed war-axe chased with filigree and a winged angel motif, its haft banded in polished brass that gleams like an altar piece.

weapons.name: Splitbeard Hatchet
weapons.description: A compact bearded one-hand axe with a chipped grey edge and a sweat-darkened ash haft worn smooth by gripping hands.

weapons.name: Sanctus Mace
weapons.description: A flawless six-flanged steel mace with a silver-chased grip and a domed pommel that shines without a single dent, every flange honed to a clean ridge.

weapons.name: Thunderfall Warhammer
weapons.description: An immense square-headed warhammer engraved with storm-lines and capped in blued steel, its head so heavy each strike lands like a tolling thunderclap.

weapons.name: Lance of the Silver Vigil
weapons.description: A long bright-steel spear with a slender leaf-shaped head and a banner-loop at the socket, perfectly balanced for a clean piercing lunge.

weapons.name: Glaivewing Halberd
weapons.description: A tall ceremonial halberd crowning a crescent axe, a needle spike, and a back-hook all in etched silvered steel, sweeping in wide commanding arcs.

weapons.name: Heaven's Folded Moon
weapons.description: A flawless mirror-polished katana with a silver crescent-moon tsuba and a snow-white silk-wrapped hilt, its edge so clean it seems to cut the light itself.

weapons.name: Ashfall Nodachi
weapons.description: An enormous field-sword scarred with notches and soot, its overlong blade trailing a faint smolder of embers as it carves a wide horizontal sweep.

weapons.name: Jade Serpent Jian
weapons.description: A gleaming straight double-edged jian inlaid with jade scales and a tasselled pommel, threading precise arcane thrusts that shimmer like coiling green light.

weapons.name: Tiger-Stripe Dao
weapons.description: A heavy single-edged saber with a chipped, oil-darkened blade and a brass disc-guard worn smooth, built for brutal hacking cleaves.

weapons.name: Frostpetal Naginata
weapons.description: A long polearm topped with a gleaming curved blade etched in falling-cherry-blossom frostwork, its sweeping reach leaving a trail of glittering rime.

weapons.name: Thunder-Oni Tetsubo
weapons.description: A massive iron-studded war-club, its knuckled spikes pitted and rust-streaked, crashing down in earth-shaking overhead slams that spit blue sparks.

weapons.name: Gilded Crane Sai
weapons.description: A matched pair of pronged truncheons plated in polished gold with crane-engraved shafts, darting in rapid dual-handed stabs and parries.

weapons.name: Pilgrim's Oaken Bo
weapons.description: A long road-smoothed hardwood staff banded with tarnished iron caps, sweeping in broad two-handed arcs with quiet, grounded discipline.

weapons.name: Twin Lotus Butterfly Swords
weapons.description: A gleaming pair of short broad-bladed hudiedao with brass D-guards and lotus-etched spines, flashing through tight scissoring dual-blade flurries.

weapons.name: Venomtide Returning Dao
weapons.description: A balanced throwing-saber slick with green poison residue and a knotted return-cord stud, hurled spinning at a foe before snapping back to the hand.

weapons.name: Coronation Edge
weapons.description: A gilded ceremonial longsword whose mirror-bright blade is etched with the royal blazon and whose crossguard blooms into filigreed gold laurels.

weapons.name: Throne-Ward Greatblade
weapons.description: An immaculate two-handed parade greatsword of polished white steel, its broad fuller inlaid with a sapphire-set scrollwork that has never seen a scratch.

weapons.name: Prismward Aegis-Mace
weapons.description: A flanged ceremonial mace grown from a single flawless crystal, each facet refracting cold light into a shimmer of frost as it falls.

weapons.name: Twin Regent Stilettos
weapons.description: A matched pair of slender gold-chased court stilettos, jeweled pommels flashing as they cross in a glittering flurry of cuts.

weapons.name: Solemnity, the Gemforged Partisan
weapons.description: A tall ceremonial guard's partisan whose mirror-polished head is socketed with a ring of cut rubies that trail a holy gleam through each sweeping reach.

weapons.name: Cinderfang Maul
weapons.description: A blackened iron warhammer whose cracked head glows molten orange in its seams, leaving a smear of embers in the air on every brutal downswing.

weapons.name: Glaciem Spire
weapons.description: An elegant lance carved from a single shaft of eternal blue ice, its faceted point trailing crystalline frost-motes and rimed with delicate filigree.

weapons.name: Marrowsplit
weapons.description: A broad cleaving axe whose head is a single fused jawbone, teeth still socketed along the edge and the haft wrapped in cracked yellow sinew that flexes with every chop.

weapons.name: Glasswidow's Edge
weapons.description: A pair of mirror-polished obsidian shortblades, each chipped to a glassy black razor that throws back the light, balanced for blink-fast paired slashes.

weapons.name: Menhir Maul
weapons.description: A monolithic standing-stone hammer lashed to a thick timber haft, its weathered grey face carved with spiral glyphs that catch grit and shadow as it falls.

weapons.name: Heartwood Reaver
weapons.description: A long greatsword grown rather than forged, its blade a single length of hardened heartwood veined with living amber sap that pulses faintly green along the cutting edge.

weapons.name: Tidecaller's Trident
weapons.description: An elegant three-pronged spear of branching rose-and-white coral, each tine flared into a fan of fluted barbs that gleam wet as if just lifted from the reef.

weapons.name: Gorehorn Goad
weapons.description: A heavy boar-tusk lance bound to a hide-wrapped shaft, the ivory horn scarred and amber-stained from countless gorings, built to drive forward in brutal thrusts.

weapons.name: Wraithedge Twins
weapons.description: A matched pair of jagged shadow-iron punch daggers, their pitted blades fading into smoky nothingness at the tips as they slash in a blur.

weapons.name: Seraph's Verdict
weapons.description: A gleaming, flawless longsword of polished white-gold that radiates a soft halo of light, its mirror-bright edge humming with sanctified warmth.

weapons.name: Vael-9 Railspear
weapons.description: A long, mirror-white anti-materiel railgun with twin parallel rails sheathed in a gleaming ceramic shell, its capacitor coils glowing pale blue as it winds up a single hypervelocity slug.

weapons.name: Halcyon Coilrifle
weapons.description: An elegant gauss marksman rifle plated in brushed rose-gold with filigree-etched coil rings stacked down the barrel, humming with a clean magnetic whine before each precise shot.

weapons.name: Sunfleck Plasma Pistol
weapons.description: A compact, gleaming-white sidearm with a glassy amber containment bulb at the muzzle that spits a fat bolt of fiery plasma with a soft thermal pop.

weapons.name: Aurora Beam Lance
weapons.description: A slender, polished-chrome lance that projects a continuous lance of cold violet light, its focusing prism crowned with a halo of frost-blue emitter fins.

weapons.name: Hornet Smart-SMG
weapons.description: A stubby, scuffed gunmetal machine pistol with a chittering targeting eye on top, hosing out a fast auto-stream of self-correcting smart rounds.

weapons.name: Twin Voltaire Carbines
weapons.description: A matched pair of sleek pearl-white energy carbines that crackle with arcs of blue lightning, fired akimbo in alternating shock bursts.

weapons.name: Tempest Scattergun
weapons.description: A broad-mouthed energy shotgun with a faded steel-grey casing and a wide emitter throat that belches a fan of superheated plasma motes at close range.

weapons.name: Sentinel Gauss Bastion
weapons.description: A tripod-mounted heavy gauss cannon in immaculate arctic-white armor, its enormous coil throat winding up to drive auto-fed magnetic slugs across the whole arena.

weapons.name: Glasswing Beam Carbine
weapons.description: A gracefully tapered carbine of translucent aquamarine glass-alloy with gilt vein-tracery, sustaining a thin holy-gold ray as long as the trigger is held.

weapons.name: Wasp Toxin Repeater
weapons.description: A grime-streaked olive-drab smart-SMG fitted with a sloshing green reservoir, dumping bursts of corrosive toxin darts that streak in on locked targets.

weapons.name: Nullspike Railpistol
weapons.description: A jewel-precise one-handed railgun pistol of polished obsidian-and-silver, its short rails tearing open a sliver of void that hurls a humming dark-matter slug.

weapons.name: Arbalest of the Iron Vow
weapons.description: A heavy steel arbalest of mirror-bright plates and a polished walnut stock, its windlass crank gleaming like fresh-forged armor as it punches a single bolt clean through a line of foes.

weapons.name: Hartwood Longbow
weapons.description: A tall, hand-rubbed yew warbow gone amber-brown with use, its waxed string and antler nocks loosing a long, arcing shaft that drops onto distant targets.

weapons.name: Hailfang Repeater
weapons.description: A boxy, lever-fed repeating crossbow scarred from a hundred skirmishes, rattling out a stuttering hail of short bolts as fast as the wielder can pump its rigid arm.

weapons.name: Bandolier of Whispering Axes
weapons.description: A pair of matched throwing hatchets with etched silver bits and leather-wrapped hafts that hum end-over-end through the air and come whirling back to the hand.

weapons.name: Sunspear Javelins
weapons.description: A clutch of slender gold-tipped javelins that blaze with holy light the instant they leave the grip, each cast streaking like a sunbeam to spear a single far enemy.

weapons.name: Hagoromo Yumi
weapons.description: A towering gloss-black asymmetric yumi bound in pale rattan rings, its arrow leaving a faint ribbon of white feather-down as it looses with a deep resonant snap.

weapons.name: Sunfeather Daikyu
weapons.description: A radiant gold-leafed daikyu engraved with chrysanthemum filigree whose nocked shaft bursts into a streaking ember-arrow that trails fire across the field.

weapons.name: Sparrowfall Kunai
weapons.description: A pair of nicked, oil-darkened kunai gripped between the fingers and hurled in rapid blurring volleys that thud home with a wet metallic bite.

weapons.name: Venomwheel Shuriken
weapons.description: A dull grey bandolier of eight-pointed shuriken slick with green resin, loosed in a hissing fan that scatters across a wide arc and leaves victims dripping toxin.

weapons.name: Tessen of the Falling Petal
weapons.description: A lacquered war fan painted with cherry blossoms over gleaming iron ribs that flares open with a sharp clack to fling a crescent of cutting wind in a sweeping spread.

weapons.name: Sunburst Dueling Pistol
weapons.description: An exquisite gold-filigreed flintlock dueling pistol, its mirror-bored barrel and engraved lockplate spitting a single clean, sunlit shot.

weapons.name: Palace Longrifle Ceremonial
weapons.description: A pristine ivory-stocked honor-guard longrifle chased in silver scrollwork, delivering a flawless long-range shot with regal precision.

weapons.name: Royal Volley Coachgun
weapons.description: A gleaming double-barreled ceremonial coachgun with engraved gold breech and pearl inlay, scattering a bright fan of polished shot.

weapons.name: Lustrous Court Longbow
weapons.description: A flawless laminated court longbow lacquered to a high gloss and tipped in gold, loosing crystalline arrows that streak clean across the arena.

weapons.name: Stormcaller Repeater
weapons.description: A sleek brass-and-cobalt lever rifle whose coiled barrel crackles with arcing blue current, spitting hitscan lightning-bolts with a thunderclap report.

weapons.name: Umbral Quietus
weapons.description: A pair of obsidian flintlocks wreathed in writhing shadow, firing slugs of compressed darkness that drink the light around their muzzles.

weapons.name: Viperbloom Scattergun
weapons.description: A grotesque shotgun grown from a hollowed serpent-spine, belching a wide spray of hissing green venom-darts from its dripping fanged maw.

weapons.name: Prism Lance
weapons.description: A gleaming bow grown from a single shard of clear quartz, its limbs refracting light into thin rainbows and loosing hardened crystal slivers in a tight, glinting line.

weapons.name: Sporeburst Censer
weapons.description: A bulbous puffball mounted on a stubby living-wood handle that, when flung, ruptures mid-air into a spreading cone of glowing toxic spores.

weapons.name: Chitin Spitter
weapons.description: A living hand-cannon of hardened insect carapace that contracts and spits clusters of barbed chitin darts in a quick scattering volley, twitching faintly as it reloads.

weapons.name: Aurora Singularity
weapons.description: A flawless mirror-chrome sphere haloed by a silent ring of violet event-horizon light, so polished it reflects the arena warped and inside-out.

weapons.name: Veil-Piercer Holo-Focus
weapons.description: A gold-filigreed disc afloat above the palm, casting a stacked tower of luminous concentric rings that channel into a thin sapphire beam.

weapons.name: Cinder-Loom Plasma Scepter
weapons.description: A slender platinum rod crowned with a fixed crystalline brazier where a contained sun churns, throwing a flickering corona of white-orange heat.

weapons.name: Glacier Codex
weapons.description: A levitating book of frosted glass pages bound in chrome, its open spread scrolling pale-blue glyphs that crystallize into mist as they turn.

weapons.name: Hivemind Nanite Emitter
weapons.description: A scuffed gunmetal vent-array clamped to the forearm, its grilles weeping a faint green haze of microscopic machines that hangs and creeps in the air.

weapons.name: Stormvault Energy-Core Staff
weapons.description: A tall white-ceramic stave with a caged blue fusion core suspended at its head, arcs of static crawling up the seamless shaft to a fixed prong tip.

weapons.name: Reliquary of Last Light
weapons.description: An ornate cathedral-cut reliquary of white gold and stained crystal, a fixed halo of golden light suspended in its hollow that pours out a warm radiant ray.

weapons.name: Twin Quanta Foci
weapons.description: A matched pair of palm-sized iridescent prisms, each humming with a caged spark, firing rapid twinned darts of crackling violet light in alternation.

weapons.name: Embergate Energy-Core Staff
weapons.description: A blackened obsidian-composite stave scored with heat-cracks, its molten amber core glowing dully behind a soot-clouded containment lens.

weapons.name: Null-Spire Gravity Orb
weapons.description: A spotless ivory-plated orb braced on a shoulder mount, its central black aperture exhaling a steady ribbon of dimming, light-eating darkness.

weapons.name: Permafrost Data-Tome
weapons.description: A sealed slab of blue-veined crystal etched with running runic code, snapping open just long enough to spit one precise, glittering needle of cold.

weapons.name: Stormcaller Runestaff
weapons.description: A black ashwood stave crowned with a floating, rune-carved crystal that crackles violet sparks, unleashing a sustained lance of forked lightning down the line of sight.

weapons.name: Tome of Cinders
weapons.description: A scorched leather grimoire with brass-bound, ember-rimmed pages that flips itself open to vomit a fan of roaring flame across everything ahead.

weapons.name: Scepter of the Hallowed Dawn
weapons.description: A flawless white-gold scepter set with a radiant sunstone that hovers above the haft, hurling glowing orbs of holy light that burst on impact.

weapons.name: Reliquary of the Frozen Saint
weapons.description: An ornate silver reliquary casket rimed in everlasting frost, its tiny glass window weeping cold mist as it conjures a creeping field of killing ice on the ground.

weapons.name: Plaguebearer's Censer
weapons.description: A corroded brass censer crusted with green resin and clinging fungus that swings open on rigid hinges to belch a billowing cloud of corrosive spores around the caster.

weapons.name: Voidpiercer Wand
weapons.description: A slim obsidian wand tipped with a pulsing sliver of starless dark, drilling a thin, humming beam of pure void straight through anything caught in its line.

weapons.name: Thunderscript Ofuda
weapons.description: A fan of crackling vermilion talisman slips inscribed with glowing kanji that the caster flicks to the ground, where they flare and erupt in a snapping lattice of blue-white lightning.

weapons.name: Hollow Lantern Ofuda
weapons.description: A bundle of ash-grey warding papers bound to a black willow handle that, held aloft, pours forth a wavering ribbon of devouring void-shadow that gnaws at whatever it touches.

weapons.name: Frostbloom Maiōgi
weapons.description: An immaculate pearl-and-silver dance fan that, swept in a slow arc, breathes out a glittering cone of frost crystals that rimes everything in its path with ice.

weapons.name: Hundred-Blessing Juzu
weapons.description: A looped strand of polished ivory prayer beads warm with golden inner light that, clasped between the palms, projects a steady radiant beam of holy fire that burns the unclean.

weapons.name: Onyx Mala of Ruin
weapons.description: A heavy obsidian mala strung with a single violet relic-bead that the caster casts forward to plant a glowing arcane glyph on the ground, blooming into a silent purple blast.

weapons.name: Vermilion Charm-Wand
weapons.description: A red-lacquered peachwood wand crowned with a fluttering gold-flecked paper streamer that hums and spits a thin unbroken lance of fire from its glowing tip while held aloft.

weapons.name: Diadem Orb of Aurelius
weapons.description: A floating diadem-set crystal orb haloed in golden rings, channeling a steady radiant beam of focused arcane light.

weapons.name: Sceptre of the Gilded Court
weapons.description: A regal gold sceptre crowned with a luminous sapphire that calls down a placed circle of holy radiance, its jeweled head gleaming like a crown jewel.

weapons.name: Pyreheart Sigil
weapons.description: A floating ember-cored orb caged in molten brass rings that channels a roaring, sustained jet of hellfire wherever its bearer points.

weapons.name: Dawnspire Scepter
weapons.description: An immaculate ivory staff crowned with a radiant sunburst gem that calls down a blinding column of holy light onto a marked patch of ground.

weapons.name: Rimeweaver Wand
weapons.description: A slender silver wand tipped with a snowflake of living frost that exhales a continuous, freezing beam of glittering cold mist.

weapons.name: Tempest Codex
weapons.description: A levitating storm-grimoire bound in crackling clouds that, on command, drops a churning thunderhead to electrify a circle of the battlefield.

weapons.name: Geode Heart
weapons.description: A fist-sized cracked geode held aloft, its amethyst-lined hollow channeling a steady violet beam of focused arcane light from the glowing crystals within.

weapons.name: Ashen Idol
weapons.description: A gilded ancestor-skull totem inlaid with polished obsidian eyes that, when planted, erupts a circle of consecrated white flame around the caster's feet.
